title: Check a Cardano node startup problem

summary.text: While it starts, the Cardano node validates the integrity of the blockchain data on the computer. If the node reports nothing for five minutes, Daedalus shows Cardano node is not reporting progress and says that the node may still be working.

problem.text: Daedalus does not finish starting and the Cardano node shows no progress.

symptoms.text: The loading screen says Starting Cardano node for a long time.

user_phrases.text: Cardano node is not reporting progress

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.0 release notes and the 11.6.0 tag source. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

resolutions.action: When Daedalus shows Cardano node is not reporting progress, select Keep waiting to give the node more time, or Restart Cardano node if it seems stuck.
resolutions.why: Daedalus offers both choices because a silent node may still be working.

resolutions.action: If Daedalus says the Cardano node cannot start because part of the blockchain data stored on this computer is missing, select Rebuild blockchain data and confirm with Rebuild.
resolutions.why: The node cannot start without the missing data. Daedalus asks for confirmation before the rebuild, which keeps the wallets on the computer.

resolutions.action: If Daedalus says it is unable to start the Cardano node, select Open support ticket.
resolutions.why: Daedalus asks for a support request when it cannot start the node.

expected_outcome.text: The Cardano node finishes starting, or you have opened a support case from Daedalus.

consequences: The rebuild deletes the blockchain data on this computer and downloads a complete verified copy. Daedalus cannot be used until the download finishes, and your wallets stay on this computer.

evidence.rationale: Release notes, tagged source and portal pages directly state the behavior; this is source inspection, not runtime testing.

faq.reason: Common support topic with a short answer that every cited source supports.
